The source explicitly defines GenDR as a generalized differentiable renderer that models the forward process using a probability distribution with density $f$ (via its CDF $F$) and a temperature parameter $	au$. It confirms that this approach makes the renderer continuous everywhere and differentiable almost everywhere (contrasting it with the non-differentiable Dirac delta/Heaviside case). The specific formula $AO(p, T) =  igperp_{t in T} F(d(p, t)/	au)$ and the use of a T-conorm for aggregation are also directly cited in the source passages.
